_note: Hand-written client wording for each chess-tutor requirement (docs/requirements.md) and dashboard event code (config/ops-events.json). This file is the source of truth: the dashboard mirrors it on every merge to main and prints labels word for word. Written by a person, never generated. Each entry has a group and a label, or an excluded reason. Checked in CI by .claude/scripts/check-glossary.ts (NFR-18).
